context_requirements: Expression of SLC29A1 (ENT1) on the cell surface
Adenosine receptor expression (ADORA1, ADORA2A, ADORA2B, ADORA3) for downstream signaling
Adenosine kinase and/or deaminase activity to modulate intracellular adenosine
Intact cAMP/PKA and MAPK signaling pathways
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal or late genes across all nine cell lines at either time point
A clear increase in proliferation markers (e.g., MYC, CCND1, PCNA) at 24 h
No dose-dependent transcriptional response when comparing 10 µM to lower concentrations
Lack of correlation between SLC29A1 expression levels and the magnitude of transcriptional response

changes: Moved CDKN1A from late_up to proximal_down because adenosine reuptake inhibition is expected to decrease CDKN1A transcription via cAMP/PKA signaling.
Moved DDIT4 from late_up to proximal_down because mTOR inhibition by adenosine signaling is expected to decrease DDIT4 transcription.
Moved SESN1 from late_up to proximal_down because SESN1 is a p53 target and adenosine signaling is not expected to induce p53-dependent transcription.
Moved TSC22D3 from late_up to proximal_down because glucocorticoid-responsive genes are not expected to be induced by adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved HMOX1 from late_up to proximal_down because NRF2-mediated oxidative stress response is not a primary downstream effect of adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved SQSTM1 from late_up to proximal_down because autophagy induction is not a known downstream effect of adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved BNIP3 from late_up to proximal_down because hypoxia-inducible autophagy genes are not expected to be induced by adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved BNIP3L from late_up to proximal_down because hypoxia-inducible autophagy genes are not expected to be induced by adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved SERPINE1 from late_up to proximal_down because TGF-beta signaling is not a primary downstream effect of adenosine reuptake inhibition.

Moved TIMP2 from late_up to proximal_down because TGF-beta signaling is not a primary downstream effect of adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved CD44 from late_up to proximal_down because CD44 is not a known downstream target of adenosine reuptake inhibition.
Moved GADD45A from late_up to proximal_down because GADD45A is a p53 target and adenosine signaling is not expected to induce p53-dependent transcription.
Moved GADD45B from late_up to proximal_down because GADD45B is a p53 target and adenosine signaling is not expected to induce p53-dependent transcription.
